Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified "Reliable sources" (RS) as one of Wikipedia's three core content policies. The three core policies are "Neutral Point of View (NPOV)," "Verifiability (V)," and "No Original Research (NOR)." The "R" in the context of the three core policies refers to "Research" in "No Original Research," not "Reliable" in "Reliable sources." This error in identifying the policies led to the wrong conclusion about what "R" stands for in the context of the question.
